patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than Square Online's shape. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; Square Online leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs Square Online (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify.
